description: This file is a Markdown document that provides comprehensive documentation and specifications for the 'Composite Input HAL Interface', including overview, design, discovery patterns, operation flow, events, capabilities, state machines, and implementation considerations.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Manager interface for discovering and accessing composite input ports, as well as platform-wide capabilities.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Interface for controlling a specific composite input port, retrieving capabilities, and receiving events.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for port connection, signal status, and video mode change events.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving telemetry and metrics updates from ports supporting metrics.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Represents platform-wide features and support flags.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Metadata about individual port capabilities, including supported properties and metrics.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Current status of a port including connection state, signal status, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of signal statuses such as NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Details about video resolution and standard detected.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data including lock time, drops, uptime, etc.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used to batch properties for get/set operations.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Offers metadata for supported properties including type, readability, and description.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns the list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform-wide capabilities and support flags.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the interface for controlling a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Returns the metadata information about the port such as name and description.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns capabilities for the port, including supported properties and metrics.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Register a callback for port events.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Register a callback for telemetry updates.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activate or deactivate the port for video presentation.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieve the value of a specific property.
